rationale: The assistant matched the hidden truth almost exactly: explained pull-down time, that gurgling is normal, and that if laid down it should be switched off and stood upright before restarting, with 24h to judge cooling. It asked the single key unknown (transport orientation), and when the customer could not confirm it, gave the sensible low-cost default of resting it overnight, while correctly noting the compressor running and warm back as good signs rather than declaring a fault. Escalation to movers/engineer was reserved for failure to cool after the rest period plus 24h, with a practical tip about photos and claim time limits; no parts were suggested and food-safety advice (cool box) was covered.
